title: Skin analysis (analyze_skin) arguments
description: Run YouCam AI Skin Analysis on the client's photo. Returns a 0-100 score per concern (higher is healthier) and overlay images the client can see on their Skin screen. Costs 9-16 units depending on how many concerns. The face must fill most of the photo (over 60% of its width) or YouCam refuses it; a photo_problem error says how the client should retake it.

concerns.description: Concerns to score. Omit for the standard set of 8 (acne, pore, texture, wrinkle, redness, oiliness, moisture, dark_circle_v2).

photo_id.description: A specific shared photo. Omit to use the latest photo.
